string-array.name: microbreak_ideas
string-array.item: Look away from the screen for a few seconds.
Close your eyes for a moment.

string-array.name: break_ideas_texts
string-array.item: A short walk can help you clear your head and get your blood flowing.
Stretching can help relieve muscle tension and improve flexibility.
Staying hydrated is important for your health and can help you stay focused.
